lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੧੦੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran pario dukh bha(n)jan a(n)tar baahar pekh hajoore ||2||22||108||
lines.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of pain; I behold His Presence deep within, and all around as well. ||2||22||108||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਦੋਖ ਨਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan dekhat dokh nase ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, all pains run away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabahu na hovahu drisat agochar jee kai sa(n)g base ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Please, never leave my vision, O Lord; please abide with my soul. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: preetam praan adhaar suaamee ||
lines.translation: My Beloved Lord and Master is the Support of the breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: poor rahe prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||1||
lines.translation: God, the Inner-knower, is all-pervading. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa gun tere saar samhaaree ||
lines.translation: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I contemplate and remember?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas prabh tujhahi chitaaree ||2||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, O God, I remember You. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirapaa nidh prabh deen daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: God is the ocean of mercy, merciful to the meek;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t kee karahu pratipaalaa ||3||
lines.translation: He cherishes all beings and creatures. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar teraa naam jan jaape ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, Your humble servant chants Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੧੦੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak preet laaee prabh aape ||4||23||109||
lines.translation: You Yourself, O God, have inspired Nanak to love You. ||4||23||109||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਚਲਤ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan dhan joban chalat gaiaa ||
lines.translation: Body, wealth and youth pass away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਭਜਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam kaa bhajan na keeno karat bikaar nis bhor bhaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You have not meditated and vibrated upon the Lord's Name; while you commit your sins of corruption in the night, the light of day dawns upon you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਭੋਜਨ ਨਿਤ ਖਾਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਦੰਤਾ ਘਸਿ ਖੀਨ ਖਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik prakaar bhojan nit khaate mukh da(n)taa ghas kheen khaiaa ||
lines.translation: Continually eating all sorts of foods, the teeth in your mouth crumble, decay and fall out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਠਉ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ ਨਹ ਪਰੀ ਦਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: meree meree kar kar moothau paap karat nah paree daiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Living in egotism and possessiveness, you are deluded; committing sins, you have no kindness for others. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਘੋਰ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗਲਤੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikaar ghor dukh saagar tis mahi praanee galat paiaa ||
lines.translation: The great sins are the terrible ocean of pain; the mortal is engrossed in them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੧੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: saran pare naanak suaamee kee baah pakar prabh kaadh laiaa ||2||24||110||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master; taking him by the arm, God has lifted him up and out. ||2||24||110||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇਆ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa prabh aaiaa cheet ||
lines.translation: God Himself has come into my consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੁਸਟ ਰਹੇ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਤ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dusaman dusat rahe jhakh maarat kusal bhaiaa mere bhaaee meet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My enemies and opponents have grown weary of attacking me, and now, I have become happy, O my friends and Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaee biaadh upaadh sabh naasee a(n)geekaar keeo karataar ||
lines.translation: The disease is gone, and all misfortunes have been averted; the Creator Lord has made me His own.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਅਰੁ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)t sookh ar anad ghanere preetam naam ridai ur haar ||1||
lines.translation: I have found peace, tranquility and total bliss, enshrining the Name of my Beloved Lord within my heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d dhan raas prabh teree too(n) samarath suaamee meraa ||
lines.translation: My soul, body and wealth are all Your capital; O God, You are my All-powerful Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਚੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੧੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: daas apune kau raakhanahaaraa naanak daas sadaa hai cheraa ||2||25||111||
lines.translation: You are the Saving Grace of Your slaves; slave Nanak is forever Your slave. ||2||25||111||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobid simar hoaa kaliaan ||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe, I am emancipated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੀ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mitee upaadh bhaiaa sukh saachaa a(n)tarajaamee simariaa jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Suffering is eradicated, and true peace has come, meditating on the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਸੁਖਾਲੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis ke jee tin keee sukhaale bhagat janaa kau saachaa taan ||
lines.translation: All beings belong to Him - He makes them happy. He is the true power of His humble devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੀ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: daas apune kee aape raakhee bhai bha(n)jan oopar karate maan ||1||
lines.translation: He Himself saves and protects His slaves, who believe in their Creator, the Destroyer of fear. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਮਿਟੀ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਦ੍ਰੁਸਟ ਦੂਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਛਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaee mitraaee mitee buraaee drusat doot har kaadhe chhaan ||
lines.translation: I have found friendship, and hatred has been eradicated; the Lord has rooted out the enemies and villains.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਹ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥੨॥੨੬॥੧੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ghanere naanak jeevai har gunah vakhaan ||2||26||112||
lines.translation: Nanak has been blessed with celestial peace and poise and total bliss; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, he lives. ||2||26||112||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham prabh bhae kripaal ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God has become Merciful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaraj sagal savaare satigur jap jap saadhoo bhae nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has arranged all my affairs; chanting and meditating with the Holy Saints, I have become happy. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਭਏ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeaa prabh apanai dokhee sagale bhae ravaal ||
lines.translation: God has made me His own, and all my enemies have been reduced to dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਉਧਰਿ ਲੀਏ ਲਾਇ ਅਪਨੈ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)th laai raakhe jan apane udhar leee laai apanai paal ||1||
lines.translation: He hugs us close in His embrace, and protects His humble servants; attaching us to the hem of His robe, he saves us. ||1||
